rulesStrings.li: r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] walked a slow circuit of the yard with [RECIPIENT_nameDef], who is still getting [RECIPIENT_possessive] strength back.

r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] told [RECIPIENT_nameDef] [RECIPIENT_pronoun] was walking better than yesterday, and meant it.
r_logentry->[INITIATOR_nameDef] found [RECIPIENT_nameDef] a stick to lean on and cut it to the right height.
